pathAssistantSteps.info: Feasibility review delivered. Hand the opinion back to the deal team to proceed.

Engineer assesses flood plain, drainage and developability. Get at least 3 like-for-like proposals to compare, reach out to the MUD engineer (they often do the civil work too), and build the comparison sheet before taking cost up.

Junior forwards the land deal from Under Review. Confirm the drainage-study timeline with the civil engineer, flag any deal-killer cost impact to Junior, and note whether a zoning change triggers the PD process.
Summarize the feasibility findings and cost impact, and present a Go / Conditional / No-Go recommendation to Acquisitions.
Collect and compare vendor proposals on a like-for-like basis before forming an opinion.
